tools.name: calculate_car_loan_interest_deduction
tools.description: Calculates the 2025-2028 federal deduction for car loan interest created by the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (P.L. 119-21, IRC 163(h)(4)) the way IRS Schedule 1-A Part IV does: up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest, then $200 off for each $1,000 or part of $1,000 of MAGI over $100

tools.name: calculate_salt_deduction
tools.description: Calculates the deductible state and local tax (SALT) on Schedule A under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act cap (IRC 164(b)(6)-(7)): $40,000 for 2025 and $40,400 for 2026 ($20,000 / $20,200 married filing separately), rising 1% a year through 2029, reduced by 30% of MAGI over $500,000 (2025) or $505,000

tools.name: get_tax_brackets_and_standard_deduction
tools.description: Returns the official 2025 and 2026 federal income tax brackets and standard deductions after the One Big Beautiful Bill Act: 2026 standard deduction $16,100 single, $32,200 joint, $24,150 head of household (Rev. Proc. 2025-32), 2025 $15,750 / $31,500 / $23,625, plus the additional amount for age 65

tools.name: calculate_child_tax_credit
tools.description: Calculates the child tax credit as Schedule 8812 does after the One Big Beautiful Bill Act: $2,200 per qualifying child under 17 for 2025 and 2026, $500 per other dependent, reduced by 5% of MAGI over $400,000 joint / $200,000 others (excess rounded up to the next $1,000), limited by tax liability,
